## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-check-manifest-completeness.sh before check-manifest-completeness.sh exists (RED phase). Runs in parallel with T1.

## Files to Create
- tests/scripts/test-check-manifest-completeness.sh

## Test Cases (3)
1. Complete verifier JSON (all required fields present) → check-manifest-completeness.sh exits 0
2. JSON missing criteria_results field → exits 1
3. JSON with criteria_results present but missing consumer_smoke_tests key → exits 1

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-manifest-completeness.sh exits non-zero (RED — script under test does not yet exist)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-check-manifest-completeness.sh
- Test fixtures embedded in the test script (no external /tmp paths)

## Testing Mode
RED (parallel with T1)
data.title: T3: RED — Write test suite for check-manifest-completeness.sh
